adjudication_note: A draw against 2.25.0 found `CDs` matching technical.cds — but in `os CDs comprado por meio de um banco segurado pelo governo federal` it is Certificates of Deposit, not Credit Default Swaps. An acronym collision, the same shape as `IR` (Imposto de Renda vs Information Ratio) that this campaign fixed in its first batch, and the repair is the same: register the sense that was missing so the collision demoter can see the contention it could not see before.

concepts.def: A time deposit issued by a bank, insured up to a limit by the deposit guarantee scheme.
